name.description: A unique name that identifies the governance policy.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this governance policy.

policyType.description: Type of governance policy (SECURITY, DATA_QUALITY, RETENTION, PRIVACY).

status.description: Current status of the policy (DRAFT, ACTIVE, DEPRECATED, UNDER_REVIEW).

reviewDate.description: Next scheduled review date for this policy in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

mutuallyExclusive.description: When `true`, assets can only be associated with one standard from this policy. When `false`, multiple standards from this policy can be applied simultaneously.

provider.description: Provider type for this governance policy (system or user).

domains.description: Fully qualified names of the domains the Governance Policy belongs to.

reviewers.description: User references of the reviewers for this policy.

tags.description: Tags associated with this governance policy.
